premissa: Contratados para pintar uma casa, TÉO pinta embaixo de azul e JUCA em cima de rosa sem combinar nada; a tinta rosa escorre, cada um cobre o trabalho do outro com ferramentas cada vez maiores, até se encontrarem e resolverem com fita crepe.
mecanismo: Mal-entendido silencioso + regra de três (3 rodadas de escalada)
set_historia: SET: exterior of a small two-storey 1970s Czech suburban house, flat cream stucco facade with damp stains, two rows of tall casement windows with moss-green wooden shutters, a drainpipe on the right, a gravel path in front, a front door with a cream doormat on the ground floor. A simple wooden scaffold of pine poles and planks stands against the facade with a lower platform at ground-floor window height and an upper platform at first-floor window height, joined by a wooden ladder. A toolbox, a hand broom, a ball of string and a roll of masking tape hanging from a scaffold pole sit on the lower platform. Soft diffuse overcast daylight, warm colour temperature, soft short shadows.

shots.funcao_comica: Abertura fixa da série: o telefone toca e cada um pega uma lata de cor diferente sem combinar nada (planta o mal-entendido).
shots.estado: A black rotary telephone sits at the left end of the workbench. A closed blue paint tin and a closed pink paint tin stand on the floorboards beside the bench, next to a toolbox. TÉO stands at the bench, JUCA stands by the window.
shots.acao: The rotary telephone shakes on the bench as it rings. TÉO lifts the receiver, listens with his eyebrows rising slowly, nods twice and lowers the receiver onto the cradle as JUCA picks up the toolbox. Then TÉO bends to take the blue tin and JUCA takes the pink tin, and the two turn and walk toward the door together.
shots.camera: Static medium wide shot at puppet eye level, the action flowing continuously.
shots.soundscape: A rotary telephone bell ringing in sharp bursts, a plastic receiver clicking onto its cradle, a toolbox handle clanking, metal paint tins scraping on floorboards, boots stepping on wooden boards
shots.fim_estado: TÉO (esquerda) leva a lata azul, JUCA (direita) leva a lata rosa e a caixa de ferramentas; ambos andando para a porta, saindo do quadro.

shots.funcao_comica: Estabelece a geografia (dois andares de andaime) e o serviço; cada um sobe para o seu andar sem se falarem.
shots.estado: The facade is bare, grey-cream and stained. The scaffold stands against it with a roll of masking tape hanging from a pole of the lower platform. TÉO carries the blue tin, JUCA carries the pink tin and the toolbox.
shots.acao: TÉO and JUCA walk in from the left along the gravel path carrying their tins, then stop and tilt their heads back to look up at the bare facade, nodding once each. Then TÉO steps onto the lower platform and puts the blue tin down while JUCA climbs the ladder toward the upper platform with the pink tin.
shots.camera: Static wide shot at puppet eye level showing the whole facade and both scaffold levels, the action flowing continuously.
shots.soundscape: Gravel crunching under boots, metal paint tins clinking, a wooden ladder creaking rung by rung, a plank thumping under a boot
shots.fim_estado: TÉO no andar de baixo (esquerda) abrindo a lata azul; JUCA subindo a escada com a lata rosa; fita crepe pendurada no poste do andar de baixo.

shots.funcao_comica: Os dois pintam felizes e alheios um ao outro; a câmera se aproxima da linha onde as cores vão se encontrar (antecipação).
shots.estado: An open blue paint tin stands on the lower platform and an open pink paint tin stands on the upper platform. A roll of masking tape hangs from a pole of the lower platform. The wall is still mostly bare.
shots.acao: TÉO dips a long-handled roller into the blue tin and rolls a smooth blue band along the ground-floor wall, while above him JUCA dips his roller into the pink tin and rolls a smooth pink band along the first-floor wall. They work with contented nods, each unaware of the other, as the two bands grow toward each other.
shots.camera: Slow push-in from the wide framing toward the middle of the facade where the two bands will meet, the action flowing continuously.
shots.soundscape: Wet rollers squelching on stucco, paint tins clinking, planks creaking under boots, a roller handle tapping a tin rim
shots.fim_estado: Faixa azul embaixo e faixa rosa em cima, quase se tocando no meio da fachada; TÉO e JUCA ainda pintando, câmera mais próxima.

shots.funcao_comica: Insert que planta a CAUSA da falha: a tinta rosa é rala e escorre (o público vê antes dos personagens).
shots.estado: A smooth blue band covers the ground-floor wall and a smooth pink band covers the first-floor wall, with a narrow bare strip of stucco between them. The pink paint is thin and runny.
shots.acao: A fat drop of pink paint swells at the bottom edge of the pink band, then slides slowly down the stucco in a wobbling line toward the blue band and, as it touches the blue, spreads into a purple streak.
shots.camera: Static close-up on the wall where the two colours meet, the action flowing continuously.
shots.soundscape: Paint drops pattering on a wooden plank, a distant roller squelching, a plank creaking
shots.fim_estado: Escorrido rosa-roxo descendo pela faixa azul; nenhum personagem em quadro.

shots.funcao_comica: Rodada 1: TÉO reage calmo ao escorrido e cobre com azul; a gambiarra (rolo no cabo de vassoura) faz o azul invadir o rosa.
shots.estado: A purple-pink streak runs down the blue band. A hand broom and a ball of string lie on the lower platform beside the blue tin. TÉO's roller is wet with blue.
shots.acao: TÉO notices the purple streak on his blue wall, his eyebrows rising, and looks up at the planks above him. Then he shrugs calmly and rolls blue over the streak. Then he ties his roller onto the hand broom handle with a loop of string and, as he lifts the long roller high, a blue stripe climbs up into the pink band.
shots.camera: Static medium shot at puppet eye level on the lower platform, the action flowing continuously.
shots.soundscape: A roller squelching on stucco, string rasping as it is pulled tight, a broom handle knocking a scaffold pole, planks creaking
shots.fim_estado: TÉO (centro-esquerda) com o rolo amarrado ao cabo de vassoura erguido; faixa azul subindo para dentro da área rosa.

shots.funcao_comica: Rodada 2: JUCA vê o azul invadindo o rosa e responde com um cabo longo; a escalada é lógica e visível.
shots.estado: A blue stripe has climbed into the pink band beside JUCA. A long wooden pole and a ball of string lie on the upper platform. JUCA's roller is wet with pink.
shots.acao: JUCA leans over the upper rail and sees the blue stripe creeping into his pink wall, his eyebrows shooting up. Then he calmly ties his roller to a long pole and lowers it over the rail. As he sweeps the long roller down the wall beside him, a wide pink stripe covers the blue stripe and runs on downward.
shots.camera: Static low-angle shot looking up at JUCA leaning over the upper rail, the action flowing continuously.
shots.soundscape: A wooden pole scraping on a plank, string rasping as it is knotted, a roller slapping on stucco, planks creaking under boots
shots.fim_estado: JUCA (centro) no andar de cima, rolo em cabo longo varrendo a parede para baixo; faixa rosa cobrindo o azul.

shots.funcao_comica: Rodada 3: duelo de rolos; os cabos se enroscam e o enroscar vai derrubar a lata (prepara o desastre do plano 8).
shots.estado: Blue and pink stripes overlap in the middle of the facade, with splashes of purple. TÉO's roller on a broom handle and JUCA's roller on a long pole reach the same strip of wall. The open pink tin stands near the edge of the upper platform.
shots.acao: TÉO and JUCA, each on their own platform, sweep their long rollers up and down the same strip of wall, covering each other's colour. Then the two long handles cross and tangle in the middle as both tug, the rollers spinning and flicking paint across the facade while the pink tin slides toward the platform edge.
shots.camera: Static wide shot at puppet eye level showing both platforms and the whole facade, the action flowing continuously.
shots.soundscape: Rollers slapping and squelching on stucco, wooden handles knocking together, planks creaking, paint splattering on the wall
shots.fim_estado: Cabos enroscados no centro; lata rosa na borda do andar de cima, deslizando; TÉO embaixo (esquerda), JUCA em cima (direita).

shots.funcao_comica: Estoura o desastre e vem o beat de silêncio antes da reação: TÉO impassível sob a cascata rosa.
shots.estado: TÉO stands on the lower platform directly under the edge of the upper platform; the broom handle is still tangled above him. The wall behind him is a streaky mix of blue, pink and purple.
shots.acao: A thick stream of pink paint pours off the edge of the upper platform over TÉO's teal beanie and shoulders. TÉO keeps his body rigid as the paint runs down his moustache. Then he slowly raises his eyebrows and tilts his head up toward the edge as a last pink drop falls from the planks.
shots.camera: Static medium close-up on TÉO at puppet eye level, the action flowing continuously.
shots.soundscape: A paint tin tumbling and clanging on planks, thick paint glugging out of the tin, heavy paint splashing on wood, then a beat of complete silence
shots.fim_estado: TÉO coberto de rosa na boina e ombros, cabeça inclinada para cima, sobrancelhas erguidas; lata rosa vazia caída no andar de cima.

shots.funcao_comica: Plano de reação de JUCA: a consciência do erro, sem pânico.
shots.estado: The empty pink tin lies on its side on the upper platform, dripping. JUCA's clogs are splashed with pink paint.
shots.acao: JUCA leans at the upper rail looking down, his eyebrows drawing together. Then he lifts his flat cap, scratches his head and puts the cap back, and turns toward the ladder to climb down.
shots.camera: Static close-up on JUCA at the upper rail looking down, the action flowing continuously.
shots.soundscape: An empty tin rolling and rattling on planks, cap fabric rustling, a ladder creaking, last drips pattering
shots.fim_estado: JUCA virando para a escada, começando a descer; chinelos de madeira respingados de rosa.

shots.funcao_comica: Primeiro encontro: reação calma dos dois e a gambiarra que resolve (fita crepe plantada no plano 2).
shots.estado: TÉO's teal beanie and shoulders are splashed with pink paint and JUCA's clogs are splashed with pink paint. The wall is a streaky mix of blue, pink and purple. A roll of masking tape hangs from a pole of the lower platform.
shots.acao: JUCA climbs down the ladder onto the lower platform and the two face each other, then look at the streaky wall and back at each other, nodding slowly. Then JUCA lifts the roll of masking tape from the scaffold pole and walks along the platform pressing a long strip of tape across the wall at platform-rail height as TÉO follows behind him smoothing the tape flat with his palm.
shots.camera: Static medium two-shot at puppet eye level on the lower platform, the action flowing continuously.
shots.soundscape: Boots thumping down ladder rungs, a beat of complete silence, then a long tape strip peeling off its roll with a rasp, a palm smoothing tape on stucco, planks creaking
shots.fim_estado: Linha de fita crepe cruzando a fachada; JUCA à frente (direita) puxando a fita, TÉO atrás (esquerda) alisando com a palma.

shots.funcao_comica: Payoff de ordem: com a linha guia, o trabalho em sincronia (contraste com o caos anterior).
shots.estado: A strip of masking tape runs across the facade at platform-rail height. TÉO's teal beanie and shoulders are splashed with pink, JUCA's clogs are splashed with pink. The wall is still streaky.
shots.acao: TÉO rolls fresh blue below the tape line while JUCA climbs back up and rolls fresh pink above it, the two moving in the same steady rhythm. As they work, the streaky wall turns into two clean flat colours on either side of the tape.
shots.camera: Slow pull-back from the medium two-shot to a wide shot of the whole facade, the action flowing continuously.
shots.soundscape: Rollers squelching in a steady rhythm, a tin rim tapping, a paint tin scraping on planks, a plank creaking
shots.fim_estado: Enquadramento aberto mostrando a fachada inteira: duas cores limpas separadas pela fita; TÉO embaixo e JUCA em cima, ainda pintando em ritmo.

shots.funcao_comica: A revelação limpa: a linha reta aparece quando a fita sai (alívio cômico).
shots.estado: The facade is clean and two-tone: blue on the ground floor and pink on the first floor, with a strip of masking tape between them. TÉO's teal beanie and shoulders are splashed with pink and JUCA's clogs are splashed with pink.
shots.acao: JUCA peels the strip of masking tape off the wall in one long pull, revealing a crisp straight line between the blue and the pink, while TÉO wipes his moustache with the back of his hand. Then the two step back side by side and nod at each other in satisfaction.
shots.camera: Static wide shot at puppet eye level showing the whole facade, the action flowing continuously.
shots.soundscape: A long tape strip ripping off stucco, boots shuffling on planks, a paint tin lid pressed shut, palms brushing dust off cloth
shots.fim_estado: Fachada azul/rosa impecável; TÉO (esquerda) e JUCA (direita) lado a lado, acenando com a cabeça.

shots.funcao_comica: Tag final: pegadas azuis e rosas no capacho limpo e a última gota rosa na boina de TÉO (colhe a causa plantada no plano 4).
shots.estado: The facade is clean two-tone, blue below and pink above. The cream doormat in front of the door is clean. TÉO's boots are splashed with blue paint and JUCA's clogs with pink paint. TÉO's teal beanie is splashed with pink.
shots.acao: TÉO and JUCA walk across the cream doormat past the front door toward the gravel path, leaving alternating blue and pink footprints behind them. As they go, a last fat drop of pink paint falls from the scaffold onto TÉO's beanie and he walks on without noticing.
shots.camera: Static low-angle shot at the foot of the front door, the action flowing continuously.
shots.soundscape: Boots and clogs squelching on a doormat, paint tins clinking, a single paint drop plopping on a plank, gravel crunching
shots.fim_estado: Os dois saindo de quadro pela direita, pegadas coloridas no capacho.
